title: Local-Style Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A Malaysian-style bolognese using frozen beef mince, tinned tomato puree, fresh tomato and Italian herbs — a budget-friendly, crowd-pleasing pasta dish.
description_ms: Spaghetti bolognese gaya Malaysia menggunakan daging beku, tomato puree tin, tomato segar dan rempah Itali — mudah, murah dan sedap untuk open house.
steps: Fry 400 g frozen beef (no oil needed) until its fat renders and it browns; set aside.
Chop 1 celery stalk, 1 sweet onion, 1 carrot and 4 garlic cloves; sauté until golden.
Add 1 can tomato puree and 2 blended fresh tomatoes (blended with a little water).
Return the beef; add 0.5 tbsp oregano, 1 tbsp chilli flakes, salt, black pepper, 1 bay leaf and 1 chicken (or beef) stock cube.
Add water; cover and simmer for 15 minutes (longer = more flavour). Add more water if it dries out.
Cook spaghetti per package instructions; drain.
Serve sauce over spaghetti; top with parmesan cheese.
steps_ms: Goreng 400g daging beku (tanpa minyak) sehingga lemak cair dan daging garing; ketepikan.
Chop 1 batang salari, 1 bawang Holland, 1 carrot dan 4 ulas bawang putih; tumis sehingga keemasan.
Masukkan 1 tin tomato puree dan 2 biji tomato segar yang dah diblend (blend dengan sedikit air).
Masukkan balik daging; tambah setengah sudu oregano, 1 sudu cili flakes, garam, black pepper, 1 helai daun salam dan 1 kiub pati ayam (atau lembu).
Masukkan air; tutup dan reneh selama 15 minit (lebih lama lebih sedap). Tambah air kalau kering.
Rebus spaghetti ikut arahan pakej; toskan.
Hidang kuah di atas spaghetti; tabur parmesan cheese.
